notes: Chat template used with enable_thinking=false so the model does not emit <think> blocks; the prompt file is split on <<<USER>>> into system/user halves. trust_remote_code=true because the qwen3_5 architecture was not registered in the transformers release v1 used. Default quantization 4bit NF4 to keep VRAM ~5-6 GB. NOTE: 9B parameters is above the ~8B ceiling in configs/model_limits.json, so run_decomposer.py will refuse to run this folder until Jahid changes the ceiling.
